text:
Jean Butez keeps his place in the Como goal and Samuele Ricci returns to midfield, while Lion Lauberbach and Gianluca Busio come in for Venezia.
It kicks off at 12:30 CET [11:30 GMT] at the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia, with Maria Sole Ferrieri Caputi refereeing.
Como are fifth on 20 points after Tuesday’s 3-1 win at Torino, with goals from Ramón, Nico Paz and Martin Baturina. Cesc Fàbregas’ side have had a strong start to the season and travel to Lens in the Champions League on Wednesday.
Venezia are bottom with three points. They beat Napoli in Davide Nicola’s first game in charge, but have since lost 1-0 at Genoa and 2-0 at home to Inter, when two late own goals settled it.
Mattia Liberali is back in the Como squad after injury. Fàbregas called his return “very positive news”. Moise Kean is out for around five weeks with a problem that flared up after the international break. Assane Diao is still training apart from the group, and Jesús Rodríguez, Trevoh Chalobah and Addai are also absent.
Venezia are without Bartol Franjić (shoulder surgery) and Andrea Adorante (back surgery). Thierry Correia (hamstring) and Marin Šverko (hip) miss out.
Neither side has any players suspended.
Como vs. Venezia – official line-ups
Como: Butez; Yan Couto, Ramón, Kempf, Kaiki; Ricci, Milla; Da Cunha, Nico Paz, Baturina; Douvikas.
Coach: Fàbregas
Venezia: F. Stanković; Halhal, Moreno, Juan Jesus; Hainaut, Busio, Sohm, Helgason, Mazzocchi; Lauberbach, Adams.
Coach: Nicola
